judgments.reason: Extrapolating Israel's past pace to reach over 50% by 2030 has no factual basis in the data context.
The data confirms that gas supplies 79.7% of Israel's electricity, which equates to roughly four out of five kilowatt-hours.

requirements.evidence: In 2025 renewables provided 16.9% of Israel's electricity, compared with 1.9% in 2015.

requirements.evidence: Coal has almost disappeared but still accounts for 13.4% of generation in 2025.

requirements.evidence: Israel remains far behind Spain (55.9%) and Italy (48.8%) on renewables in 2025.
requirements.reason: The report compares Israel with two Mediterranean peers (Spain and Italy) for the latest available year (2025).
